summary: Trinity NF lookout on Backbone Ridge, a wood lookout house in 1961 and 1938 residence; listed as gone, with no source on its removal or the site today.

facts.design: Wood lookout house with a chimney 13 feet tall (1961 National Geodetic Survey description)
facts.status_note: Listed as gone (ground type) by the Forest Fire Lookout Association and as an LO site by Peakbagging; no source dates the removal

notes_for_editor: Only three sources; no build date, staffing record beyond a 1938 residence, or removal date was found. The Peakbagging table also has a Shasta County entry named Jacks Backbone / Backbone Ridge (LO site); it is probably a different site and was not used. The 1961 NGS benchmark ID is LU2121 on the Forest Lookouts page but LU2122 on Peakbagging; both are dated 1961. The FFLA type Ground does not clearly match the 1961 wood house with chimney, so the type may be stale. No photo was found.
